svg.title: cos(2x) as the difference of cos squared and sin squared
svg.desc: For x from 0 to 2 pi: dashed graphs of cos squared x and sin squared x, each between 0 and 1, and the solid graph of cos(2x), between -1 and 1 with period pi. At every x the solid height equals the blue dashed height minus the orange dashed height; for example at x = 0 it is 1 - 0 = 1 and at x = pi/2 it is 0 - 1 = -1.
